title: Ex 1.3 #2 · Subsets of {1, 2, ∅}
prompt: List all the subsets of $\{1, 2, \emptyset\}$. Enter them together as one set of sets between outer braces, like $\{\emptyset, \{1\}\}$.
answer_format: A set of sets between braces, like {∅, {1}, {1, 2}}. Spaces are optional.
hints: This set has three elements, and ∅ is one of them, so {∅} and {1, ∅} are subsets too.
A set with k elements has 2ᵏ subsets, including ∅ and the set itself: here that's 8.
solution: The set has 3 element(s), so it has 8 subset(s), from ∅ up to the whole set.
